code_examples.section: ltm rule command SCTP rto initial
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

SCTP::rto_initial
       Returns the initial value of SCTP retransmission timeout.

SYNOPSIS
       SCTP::rto_initial (clientside | serverside)?

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the initial value of SCTP retranmission timeout. Can specify the value on clientside or serverside.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
		log local0.info "SCTP retransmission timeout initial value is [SCTP::rto_initial]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.1.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
